channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: WATCH: Duct Tape Prom Outfits Help Fund College Education
item.description: ABC News' Danny New speaks with students who participated in Duck Brand's annual Stuck at Prom Scholarship Contest, where they create tuxedos and dresses entirely from duct tape.

item.title: Shaboozey surprises California couple during wedding photo shoot
item.description: A couple in Mammoth Lakes, California, got an unexpected guest while posing for wedding photos.

item.title: Trump says secret flight posed greater risk than decoy Air Force One
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent were aboard the decoy plane that left Turkey last month.

item.title: David Crowley wins Wisconsin Democratic gubernatorial primary
item.description: Crowley defeated progressive Francesca Hong and will face Republican Tom Tiffany in the general election.
